title: TransferRequested v1
description: Published to banking.transfers.requested.v1 when a transfer has passed validation and limits and has been recorded. Requests rejected before that (invalid input, limit exceeded, unknown account) never produce an event. Partition key: payload.sourceAccountId.

checkerUserId.description: Always null: nobody has approved the transfer when it is requested.

approvalRequired.description: True when the amount is above the approval threshold of its currency, so a checker other than the maker must approve it. Segregation-of-duties checks expect a TransferApproved with a checkerUserId for every such transfer.
